security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI saves/restores mepc_y during trap handling using XLEN-width CSR instructions (standard CSRRW/CSRRS/CSRRC) while the hart is in CHERI Capability Mode, causing the P-bit and capability metadata (tag, bounds, permissions) in the upper YLEN-XLEN bits to be silently lost or zeroed when the CSR is written back via SCADDR address reconstruction semantics.
security_spec.summary: If OpenSBI trap handlers access mepc as XLEN instead of YLEN on CHERI hardware, the P-bit in mepc_y is corrupted, causing MRET to resume S-mode in wrong CHERI Execution Mode—bypassing capability bounds enforcement
